caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet with a harlequin-like costume. The figure's outfit is composed of a pattern of alternating black and orange diamond shapes and includes light blue-green shoes. The marionette has two heads: the upper head is more lifelike with brown hair, blue eyes, and exaggerated red cheeks and lips, as well as prominent white teeth. The lower head has an elongated neck draped with a pink ruffle, gray and black hair sticking out at the sides, bulging blue-green eyes, red cheeks, and red lips with a pronounced frown; it is accessorized with a small green and black feather. The puppet's arms are jointed and fleshy in color, one arm raised and the other lowered, both manipulated by visible strings. The marionette is positioned with one knee on the ground and the other leg bent, while multiple strings extend upward toward the top edge of the page, indicating control by a puppeteer. The background is plain and uncolored. The artist's signature “CARST MAURER” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Two-Headed Freak
